hooks.command: file="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$file" == */scripts/*.py ]]; then python3 -c "import py_compile; py_compile.compile('$file', doraise=True)" 2>&1 || echo 'SYNTAX ERROR in $file'; fi
file="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$file" == *.designspace ]]; then echo 'WARNING: .designspace file was modified directly. Verify this was intentional — export-ufo.py regenerates these.'; fi
